name: loupe
description: Keeps agent-written UI on its design system. An authoring skill that sets the rules before the first draft, a conformance engine that correlates JSX component bindings with the CSS styling them — across stylesheets, inline styles and CSS-in-JS — names the exact token that replaces a hardcoded value, and catches composites rebuilt across files, plus hooks that report drift at write time rather than at review time. Ships profiles for the WordPress Design System and the VIP Design System, plus Archer as a reference profile for an unpublished system; a fourth is a directory, not a fork.

blocking.title: Block turns on findings
blocking.description: Governs the hook only. When on, error-severity findings stop the turn and hand the report back. When off, the hook reports only. A project with no loupe.config.json is always advisory in the hook unless this is on. `loupe check` exits 1 on error-severity findings either way, so CI and pre-commit still gate.

pane.title: Loupe pane
pane.description: Draws the conformance report in a pane beside the transcript, re-run after each edit the model makes to a UI file, with a status-line tally and a notification when a turn ends with blocking findings. Opens itself only in a project that opted the hooks in; /loupe-pane opens it anywhere. The hooks are unaffected either way.

preset.title: Preset
preset.description: auto, or any bundled preset (`loupe presets` lists them — wpds, wordpress-components, wordpress-block-theme, archer, vip, base-ui, generic). 'auto' infers the preset from the markers each preset declares. A project's own loupe.config.json always wins.

project_prefixes.title: Project class prefixes
project_prefixes.description: Comma-separated CSS class prefixes your projects own, e.g. 'acme-, ac-'. Leave empty to infer per project. Only these can be reported dead.

off.title: Silence the hook
off.description: When on, the hook checks nothing in any project, even one that opted in, and says only that it was skipped. To silence one project instead, put "env": { "LOUPE_OFF": "1" } in its .claude/settings.local.json. `loupe` typed by hand is unaffected.

max_attempts.title: Fix attempts before standing down
max_attempts.description: Re-checks per session before the gate lets the turn through.

max_findings.title: Findings shown per report
max_findings.description: Cap per report, sampled across rules.

typesafe_api_key.title: TypeSafe API key
typesafe_api_key.description: Lets the hooks ask Jev (TypeSafe) the judgement questions. With a key, a hook run that blocks sends TypeSafe's API (api.typesafe.ai) the file path and the lines around each finding it prints (the flagged element or declaration and its neighbours, never a whole file); a PostToolUse that hands the agent advisory context judges those findings too, within the findings cap and the answer cache; and a Stop that does not block sends nothing unless you set patterns/judged-redirect to block. Leave empty to keep every run local. Kept in your system keychain. Hooks only: for /loupe-fix --judge and the terminal, also put TYPESAFE_API_KEY=... in ~/.config/loupe/.env.
